sections.title: NRN ROCKIES/PLAINS AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: UPPER RIDGE IS EXPECTED BUILD NWD ACROSS THE SRN/CNTRL PLAINS INTO THE DAY2 PERIOD WITH THE CENTER OF THE HIGH EXPECTED TO SETTLE OVER NRN OK/SRN KS BY 15/12Z. WITH SUBSIDENCE EXPECTED TO INCREASE BENEATH THIS FEATURE IT APPEARS A CONCENTRATED ZONE OF CONVECTION WILL EVOLVE ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE NRN ROCKIES...EWD INTO THE DAKOTAS ALONG THE NWRN PERIPHERY OF THE ANTICYCLONE. LATE EVENING MODELS SUGGEST AN EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER BC/AB WILL GLANCE WRN MT BY LATE AFTERNOON WHICH SHOULD PROVE INSTRUMENTAL IN ROBUST THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD EVOLVE WITHIN A FAIRLY STRONG BAROCLINIC ZONE FAVORABLE FOR ROTATING UPDRAFTS AS SWLY FLOW ON THE ORDER OF 30-50KT SHOULD OVERSPREAD MT COINCIDENT WITH CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. ALTHOUGH LOW LEVEL FLOW MAY BE SOMEWHAT DISORGANIZED AND RELATIVELY WEAK NEAR THE FRONTAL ZONE...ONCE ACTIVITY EVOLVES AND BEGINS TO PROPAGATE TOWARD THE ERN PLAINS OF MT MORE FAVORABLE ELY LOW LEVEL INFLOW SHOULD ENCOURAGE UPWARD GROWTH WITHIN A MORE MOIST/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. WHILE INITIAL TSTMS MAY BE MORE DISCRETE IN NATURE IT WOULD SEEM PROBABLE THAT ONE OR TWO MCSS SHOULD EVOLVE ACROSS SRN/ERN MT THEN SPREAD EWD ALONG

sections.title: GULF STATES
sections.text: VERY HIGH PWAT VALUES...2-2.5 INCHES...CONTINUE ACROSS MUCH OF THE GULF STATES JUST SE OF INFLUENCE OF DOMINANT UPPER RIDGE. SHORT RANGE GUIDANCE SUGGESTS A WEAK MID LEVEL CIRCULATION MAY DEVELOP OVER SRN AL/FL PANHANDLE OVER THE NEXT FEW DAYS WHICH COULD FOCUS NUMEROUS SHOWERS/THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS THIS REGION. GIVEN THE LACK OF MEANINGFUL SHEAR BUT VERY MOIST PROFILES ANY STORMS THAT DEVELOP ACROSS THIS REGION COULD PRODUCE LOCAL MICRO BURSTS...HOWEVER ACTIVITY SHOULD BE TOO SPARSE TO WARRANT A SLIGHT RISK. ..DARROW/HURLBUT.. 07/14/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: CNTRL/SRN RIDGE WILL REMAIN DOMINANT THIS PERIOD...WITH SOME AMPLIFICATION EXPECTED NNE INTO THE UPR MS VLY AS W CST LOW/TROUGH FURTHER ELONGATE. NRN PART OF THE WRN TROUGH --- THE UPR LOW NOW OVER SRN BC --- SHOULD ACCELERATE ENE INTO ERN AB/NW MT BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. FARTHER S...WEAKER IMPULSE IN SRN BRANCH OF FLOW NOW OVER WY LIKELY WILL CONTINUE NE INTO CNTRL SD BY EARLY EVE...AND SHOULD REACH THE ND/MN BORDER BY 12Z FRI. AT THE SFC...LEE TROUGH AND LOW WILL PERSIST OVER THE NRN HI PLNS TODAY. THE LOW AND ASSOCIATED WARM FRONT NOW EXTENDING ESE ACROSS SD SHOULD ADVANCE SLOWLY NEWD LATER TODAY/TNGT AS GRT LKS SFC HIGH CONTINUES EWD.

sections.title: NRN RCKYS INTO NRN/CNTRL PLNS TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: APPROACH OF UPR LOW FROM BC...AND ASSOCIATED JET STREAK ON S SIDE OF SYSTEM...WILL GLANCE WRN/NRN MT BY LATE TODAY. COUPLED WITH SFC HEATING AND THE PRESENCE OF AMPLE MOISTURE /PW AROUND .75 INCH/...EXPECT SCTD TO NUMEROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WRN/S CNTRL MT. THESE WILL EVOLVE IN A SEASONABLY STRONG BAROCLINIC ZONE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH SVR WIND/HAIL...WITH 50 KT SWLY FLOW AT 500 MB. LOW LVL WINDS WILL...HOWEVER...REMAIN WEAK IN CNTRL MT GIVEN LOOSELY ORGANIZED LEE LOW/TROUGH IN THE ERN PART OF THE STATE. BUT THE STORMS WILL ENCOUNTER INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE CONDITIONS FOR INTENSIFICATION AS THEY MOVE/DEVELOP ENE TOWARD THE LWR PLNS AND INTO MOIST /PW AOA 1.25 INCHES/ ESELY LOW LVL FLOW LATER THIS AFTN AND EVE. THE ACTIVITY THEREFORE MAY POSE A RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND TORNADOES...IN ADDITION TO HIGH WIND. WHILE THE CNTRL MT CNTRL STORMS PREDOMINANTLY SHOULD BE DISCRETE...CONDITIONS APPEAR FAVORABLE FOR UPSCALE DEVELOPMENT INTO ONE OR TWO MCSS THAT SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE NE OR ENE INTO ERN MT AND POSSIBLY WRN ND BY EARLY FRI. FARTHER SE...UNCERTAINTIES REMAIN REGARDING THE LIKELIHOOD FOR LATE DAY STORM DEVELOPMENT INVOF SD WARM FRONT. HOWEVER...RISING

sections.title: GULF STATES THIS AFTN
sections.text: HIGH PW /AOA 2 INCHES/ WILL PERSIST OVER MUCH OF THE GULF STATES...ON SRN SIDE OF UPR RIDGE. A WEAK DISTURBANCE MOVING WWD FROM THE NERN GULF MAY PROVIDE SUFFICIENT UPR DIFFLUENCE TO AUGMENT DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE REGION. THE PRESENCE OF NUMEROUS STORMS IN A VERY MOISTURE-RICH...WEAK SHEAR ENVIRONMENT MAY YIELD A FEW WITH WET MICROBURSTS. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 07/14/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: PACIFIC NW SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL SHIFT NEWD INTO SOUTH CENTRAL CANADA TONIGHT...WITH THE SRN EXTENT OF THIS TROUGH BRUSHING MT LATER TODAY. THIS WILL RESULT IN WEAK SURFACE LOW PRESSURE IN MT AND SWD EXTENDING LEE TROUGH TO SHIFT SLOWLY EWD. A WARM FRONT STRETCHING FROM THE MT LOW EWD INTO NRN SD/IA WILL SHIFT SLOWLY NWD INTO SRN ND/CENTRAL MN OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES/PLAINS
sections.text: CONVECTION WAS ONGOING THIS MORNING WEST OF THE MT DIVIDE IN FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH UPPER TROUGH AND A SPEED MAX IN ID. AS THIS FORCING SHIFTS NEWD AND TEMPERATURES WARM...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD/DEVELOP ACROSS CENTRAL MT THIS AFTERNOON. MODERATE INSTABILITY AND DEEP LAYER SHEAR NEAR 50 KT FAVOR SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE AS THE STORMS SPREAD INTO ERN MT...WHERE BOUNDARY LARGER MOISTURE AND LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE STRONGER... THOUGH HIGH RESOLUTION MODELS SUGGEST STORMS SHOULD CONGEAL INTO A WIND PRODUCING MCS OVER ERN MT BY EVENING. WITHIN MOIST MID/HIGH TROPICAL PLUME FROM NM NEWD INTO SD...AN UPPER IMPULSE WAS OBSERVED ON WV IMAGERY OVER FAR NERN WY. CURRENT MOTION PLACES THIS FEATURE IN NWRN SD BY MID AFTERNOON AND INTO WEST CENTRAL MN BY 06Z. DESPITE SLIGHT HEIGHT RISES... FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH UPPER IMPULSE AND STRONG DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG WARM FRONT FAVOR AT LEAST ISOLATED STORMS FORMING LATER THIS AFTERNOON. STORMS THAT DO DEVELOP WILL BE IN STRONGLY SHEAR/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...FAVORING SUPERCELLS WITH A TORNADO OR TWO...LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. PAST FEW NAM RUNS SUGGEST THE MT MCS WILL SHIFT EW

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED DIURNAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE ONCE AGAIN EXPECTED TO FORM OVER THE CO/WY HIGHER TERRAIN AND NEAR SFC TROUGH. THESE STORMS WILL EXIST ON SRN FRINGE OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT...BUT SUFFICIENT SHEAR/INSTABILITY WILL EXIST FOR MULTICELL STORMS WITH A SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT.

sections.title: GULF STATES
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED OVER THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON DUE TO WEAKLY CAPPED AND MOIST ENVIRONMENT...PW/S AOA 2 INCHES. ALTHOUGH WINDS/SHEAR THROUGHOUT THE TROPOSPHERE WILL BE VERY WEAK...THE VERY MOIST VERTICAL SOUNDINGS COMBINED WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE 90S MAY YIELD A FEW WET MICROBURSTS. ..IMY/JIRAK.. 07/14/2011

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS/CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: CONVECTION THAT INITIALLY DEVELOPED OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SCNTRL MT IS SPREADING DOWNSTREAM INTO A MORE FAVORABLE AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY 60F+ SFC DEW POINTS AND MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 2000 J/KG. THIS ACTIVITY IS ORGANIZING AS EXPECTED AND A FAIRLY EXPANSIVE MCS COULD EVOLVE AS IT PROPAGATES ACROSS ERN MT INTO SWRN ND LATER THIS EVENING. OTHER MORE DISCRETE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG THE WARM FRONT OVER NWRN SD AND THESE STORMS SHOULD SPREAD EWD BENEATH THE NOSE OF THE LLJ ALONG THE ND/SD BORDER WELL INTO THE EVENING HOURS. ISOLATED TORNADOES CERTAINLY SEEM POSSIBLE GIVEN THE OBSERVED INSTABILITY/SHEAR. FARTHER SOUTH...BOTH THE LBF AND DNR SOUNDINGS SUGGEST A CONTINUED SEVERE THREAT ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...ESPECIALLY THE NEB PANHANDLE WHERE LARGE SCALE FORCING IS A BIT STRONGER THAN REGIONS SOUTH. ..DARROW.. 07/15/2011
